The company exhibits a very weak capital structure with extremely high leverage, as evidenced by total assets of 164,787M against total liabilities of 158,800M, leaving a thin shareholders' equity cushion of just 5,987M (an equity-to-assets ratio of under 4%). Operating margins are very thin at 2%, and the company is currently unprofitable with a net loss of 4M on 22,217M in revenue, though it maintains a marginally adequate current ratio of 1.18. These highly leveraged balance sheet metrics and weak profitability place the issuer in the non-investment grade speculative category, indicating substantial credit risk.

DECISION: B-
